text:
sam: Heads-up: I'm going to trigger the prefix-slot rebalance rollup for shard-group 7 in ~10m to clear small fragmented slots. Expect a brief eviction spike (~5m). Can folks run a quick hitrate + micro-bench after and paste results?
rachel: Thanks — can you post the exact command? I can run on staging now.
sam: ./tools/prefix_rebalance --group 7 --dry-run=false --max-swap=50 (run from infra box). It emits probe logs to /var/log/kv/rebalance.log
omar: Quick Q — is staging using the same eviction thresholds? We saw different behavior last week.
sam: staging uses threshold=0.60, prod=0.65. The rebalance moves absolute slots so should be comparable, but still please run: scripts/kv_hitrate.sh --since 10m --node node-stg-3 and paste the top lines.
rachel: pasted output:
```
total_queries: 125k
cache_hits: 87.3%
prefix_hits: 72.1%
evictions: 1.1k
```
matt: if prefix_hits > 70% that's generally OK. Can you also grab the admin cache snapshot? curl -s http://localhost:9100/cache_stats | jq '.prefix'
rachel: admin snapshot (trimmed): { "slots_total": 4096, "slots_active": 4023, "avg_frag": "1.8" }
omar: also let's run a micro-benchmark pre/post: bench/prefix_lookup --keys 100k --concurrency 16 on node-stg-3. I'll queue it in perf CI.
ci-bot: Perf job 872 queued — ETA ~20m. https://ci.internal/jobs/872 :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
sam: I'll run the rollup only after we see the perf numbers. Post any regressions >5% latency or >3% hitrate drop.
elaine: Reminder: rollback plan is scripts/rebalance_rollback --group 7 (no downtime). If evictions >5k, rollback immediately.
ci-bot: Perf job 872 started.
rachel: Perf job finished — node=node-stg-3
pre median latency: 2.1ms
post median latency: 2.3ms (+9.5%)
pre prefix_hitrate: 72.4%
post prefix_hitrate: 69.0%
(reb log: moved 48 slots, reclaimed 12k items, evictions spike 3.2k)
sam: +9.5% median is higher than expected. Can you attach the perf flame and rebalance.log lines? Which node again?
rachel: node-stg-3 — flame at /tmp/flame-872.svg (uploaded to perf artifacts). rebalance.log excerpt: "[12:02:11] moved slot 402 -> node-stg-5, items_reclaimed=250" and "[12:07:03] evictions=3200 spike during swap"
sam: OK hold rollup for prod. Omar, can you try targeted KV-level compaction on node-stg-3? Might be extra KV lookups from fragmented slot metadata.
omar: running kv_compact --node node-stg-3 --level 2 now. Will re-run bench after compaction.
ci-bot: Perf job 872: artifacts uploaded https://ci.internal/jobs/872/artifacts
omar: compaction finished. re-run bench results: median latency 2.15ms (vs pre 2.1ms), prefix_hitrate 71.8% (vs pre 72.4%). Slight diff but within acceptable range. I'll draft a short runbook with steps: pre-checks, rebalance flags, compaction fallback, rollback triggers.
sam: great — thanks everyone. We'll keep prod rollup blocked until we validate a canary on a second shard-group with compaction step baked in.
rachel: noted, will add bench outputs to the ticket and link artifacts. :white_check_mark:
